findings.title: Cleanup ticker interval reduced 10x without justification
findings.body: cleanup.go changes the background cleanup ticker from 10 minutes to 1 minute. The PR description only discusses annotation deadlock avoidance and does not justify running all cleanup jobs (snapshots, dashboard versions, images, invites, short URLs, query history, annotations) 10x more often. This greatly increases DB load and may itself worsen contention. Revert to 10 minutes or justify separately.

findings.title: Loop terminates on zero rows-affected instead of zero rows-fetched
findings.body: untilDoneOrCancelled stops when affected==0. In the new fetch-then-delete split, affected is RowsAffected from DELETE BY IDs. If IDs were fetched (len(ids)>0) but the DELETE affected 0 rows due to concurrent deletion or race, the loop exits as done even though more rows matching the condition may remain. Termination must be based on empty fetch (len(ids)==0), not on delete row count. Consequence is premature stop and leftover expired annotations/tags that should have been deleted in this cycle.

findings.title: Leftover Error-level logging dumps full ID batches every cycle
findings.body: CleanAnnotations and CleanOrphanedAnnotationTags log at Error level on every batch with count, full ids slice (up to AnnotationCleanupJobBatchSize, tested at 32767), cond and err (lines 534,537,554,557,576,579). This will spam error logs on every cleanup run, inflate log storage, hurt performance formatting tens of thousands of IDs, and mask real errors. These were clearly debug statements and should be removed or demoted to Debug.
